segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Maya. Can I get your company name and the email on the account?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, this is Daniel at Northstar Components. Email is daniel.cho@northstarcomp.com. I’m just looking for a copy of invoice 48291 from July, the $3,840 one.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Okay, I see the account. One second. Yeah, I’m going to put you over to the billing queue for invoice copies.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Oh, okay. I mean, I just need the PDF emailed over, but sure.

segments.speaker: Billing Agent
segments.text: Hi, this is Renee in billing. I have Daniel from Northstar Components?

segments.speaker: Billing Agent
segments.text: Great. I found invoice 48291, dated July 3, for $3,840. Do you want it sent to the email on file, daniel.cho@northstarcomp.com?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, please. If you can also copy ap@northstarcomp.com, that’d help.

segments.speaker: Billing Agent
segments.text: Done. The PDF should land in the next two or three minutes. I also added AP as a billing contact in the admin console so they receive future invoices.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect, thanks. That’s all I needed.
